description: Source code for the QuicBatchWriterBase class, implementing batching and flushing logic for QUIC packet writing in the Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBase
classes.description: Base class implementing batching, buffering, and flushing logic for QUIC packet writing.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet, marking write_blocked_ if blocked.

methods.name: InternalWritePacket
methods.description: Handles the internal logic of writing or buffering a packet, including size checks and release time handling.

methods.name: CheckedFlush
methods.description: Performs a flush if there are buffered writes, with internal consistency checks.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Externally triggers a flush of buffered packets, handling errors and blocking states.
